proposal: Two-storey rear extension to a terraced house

pages.text:
Site: 16 Plover Street, Eastmere
Dwelling: mid-terrace, 3 bedrooms
Proposal: two-storey rear extension
Parking: on-street

The extension projects 3.9 m beyond the original rear wall.
A first-floor side window faces No. 18 at 6 m; it will be obscure-glazed.
The garden ash tree is 6.5 m from the new footings.

Our measurements show the extension projecting 4.3 m, not 3.9 m.
The side window would look straight into our bedroom.

Ash T1, not protected; root protection area radius 5.2 m.
Footings at 6.5 m are outside the root protection area.
